training.title: Training & help
training.subtitle: Everything you need to learn your job in LockerFlow

tour.title: Guided tour
tour.body: A short tour of the screens you will work on every day, chosen for your role.

assistant.body: Ask the AI assistant in Arabic about any workflow and it will answer from your company's approved documentation.
assistant.disabled: The AI assistant is not enabled on this server. Contact your system administrator.

resources.title: More resources
resources.body: Written guides you can come back to at any time.
resources.manualHint: A detailed walkthrough of every screen
resources.releasesHint: What changed in the system recently

welcome.title: Welcome to LockerFlow
welcome.body: A short tour of the screens you will use in your work. You can skip it at any time and restart it later from the training page.

assistant.title: The AI assistant
assistant.body: This button is on every page. Press it and ask about any step — it answers from your company's documentation.

training.title: The training page
training.body: Restart this tour whenever you like, and find the user manual and other training resources here.

done.title: Tour complete
done.body: You are ready to start. Whenever you need help, press the AI assistant button and ask.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Where your day starts: active bookings, what is waiting for you, and your shift status.

pos.title: New transaction
pos.body: Where every sale or booking begins: pick the activity, then the customer, then take payment.

operations.title: Active operations
operations.body: Everything running right now — hand-overs, retrievals and anything overdue.

shift.title: Shift
shift.body: Open your shift at the start of the day and close it with a cash count at the end.

board.title: Delivery board
board.body: The delivery tasks assigned to you, in order. Every job starts here.

history.title: Completed deliveries
history.body: A record of what you have finished, to refer back to.

board.title: Trip board
board.body: The trips assigned to you today, their times, and how many passengers.

voyage.title: Chart & sail
voyage.body: Start the trip here and follow it through to the return.

overview.title: Manager dashboard
overview.body: Revenue, operations and your team in one view.

live.title: Live sessions
live.body: What is happening across your sites right now — active and overdue.

team.title: Team
team.body: Add staff and set their roles and where they work.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Performance and revenue reports, ready to export.

dashboard.title: VAT & activities
dashboard.body: Revenue and VAT summarised by activity.

settlement.title: Reconciliation
settlement.body: Match card payments against what the bank actually settled.

costs.title: Costs
costs.body: Record and track expenses by category and season.

seasons.title: Seasons & payroll
seasons.body: Define seasons and attach staff costs to them.

overview.title: Company dashboard
overview.body: The state of your company: sites, teams, assets and settings.

company.title: Company & branding
company.body: Trading name, CR and VAT numbers, and the colours your staff and customers see.

team.title: Employees & roles
team.body: Create staff accounts and set their permissions and locations.
